subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw replace the shipped numbered config-backup ring with datetime filenames, and must legacy `.bak.N` files be migrated or retained during the transition?
rationale: This changes a shipped recovery artifact layout, so maintainers need to confirm the upgrade contract rather than letting an external PR delete existing rollback files by default.

options.title: Require migration-safe datetime backups
options.body: Keep the datetime direction, but only merge after legacy numbered backups are preserved or migrated and collision-safe names are proven.

options.title: Keep the numbered ring
options.body: Close or defer this PR and leave the current shipped backup ring unchanged until a broader backup-storage decision is made.

options.title: Accept cleanup on upgrade
options.body: Allow legacy numbered backups to be deleted, but document the recovery tradeoff explicitly before merge.

recommendation.title: Require migration-safe datetime backups
recommendation.body: Keep the datetime direction, but only merge after legacy numbered backups are preserved or migrated and collision-safe names are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows repeated adjacent config validation and backup-rotation work, making this the best available routing candidate for the compatibility choice.
